```js
function anomOffset(m, t){
  let off = 0;
  for(const sc of m.scripts||[]){
    if(sc.type==='burst'){
      // spikes every 4s from start, width 1.6s, height mag
      if(t>=sc.start && t<=sc.end){

      const RAMP=15;
      let w=1;
      if(t < sc.start+RAMP) w = (t-sc.start)/RAMP;
      else if(t > sc.end) w = 1-(t-sc.end)/RAMP;
      w = Math.max(0,Math.min(1,w)); w = w*w*(3-2*w);
      off += sc.mag * w;
    }
  }
  return off;
}
function frozenAt(m,t){ for(const sc of m.scripts||[]) if(sc.type==='flat' && t>=sc.start && t<=sc.end) return sc.start; return null; }

  const base = m.base + m.amp*Math.sin(2*Math.PI*t/m.period + m.phase) + 3*m.amp*vnoise(t/3, m.seed);
```

In this harness (pi-matrix AB worktree cells) there is no MCP browser tool and no Bash;

```
& "C:\Program Files\Google\Chrome\Application\chrome.exe" --headless=new --disable-gpu --hide-scrollbars `
  --window-size=1920,1080 --user-data-dir="$env:TEMP\pwX" --virtual-time-budget=100000 `
  --screenshot="<abs path>.png" "file:///<abs page>.html"
```

- `--virtual-time-budget=N` fast-forwards N ms of `setInterval` timers before the shot —
  lets a live-simulating page stream minutes of ticks in seconds. Budgets of 100000 work;
  an early single failure at 90000 was a fluke, retry before concluding.
- Do NOT append `2>$null` to the whole call — the redirect made the screenshot silently
  not get written once; pipe output through `Select-Object` instead.
- For interaction evidence without an automation tool: support a URL hash in the app
  (`#m=<id>&f=<filter>`) and screenshot deep links.
- Verify page state via `--dump-dom` (grep the dumped HTML) when a value looks wrong.
